name: Alpha Strike
summary: The Horde's stalemate with the Woodpaw gnolls may be broken by striking their leaders in quick succession. Hadoken Swiftstrider asks you to bring down five Alphas within one hour.

sections.title: Five Alphas in an Hour
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider believes the Woodpaw ranks will fall into chaos if their Alphas die one after another. The blows may also show the gnolls that the Horde can destroy them. He asks you to carry out the plan. Five Alphas must fall within one hour, or the stalemate continues.

sections.title: Afterwards
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider expects the slain leaders and thinner ranks to make the gnolls hesitate before storming the camp. He still needs to learn what has driven them into such a frenzy. He hopes to find out before they regroup.

faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider gives you this work as he faces the Horde's stalemate against the Woodpaw gnolls.
The plan depends on the Alphas falling in quick succession to throw the gnoll ranks into chaos. Five must fall within one hour.
The Alphas are leaders among the Woodpaw gnolls, who call themselves Alphas.

faq.q: How many Alphas must I kill?
faq.answer: You must kill five Alphas within one hour, then return to Hadoken Swiftstrider.
